description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Luneth (Wind)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Luneth (Wind)
description.text: Increases [Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Luneth (Wind) after using a Wind ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Jump (III)+
description.text: Six single ranged jump attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Heavenly Gust+
description.text: Three single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Luneth (Wind)
description.text: One single ranged jump attack (3.36) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [100% Critical 3]/[Damage +50% 1] and [Quick Cast 1] to all allies/all FF3 allies

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
